blocks.content: Create a program to subtract coordinates.

items: Create a class named Coordinate with two integer variables x and y to store values of x and y coordinates.
Create a constructor to initialize the value of x and y.
In main(), get 4 coordinate inputs for variables x1, y1, x2, and y2.
Create an object c1 of Coordinate with arguments x1 and y1.
Create another object c2 of Coordinate with arguments x2 and y2.
Subtract the x coordinates of c1 and c2 objects and assign the result to x_diff.
Subtract y coordinates of c1 and c2 objects and assign the result to y_diff.
Print the values of x_diff and y_diff.
